run_single_image_chat: run single image inference against a vLLM served model using the OpenAI chat completion client
run_multi_image_chat: run multi image inference by sending two images to a vLLM served vision model via OpenAI client
run_audio_chat: run audio inference by sending base64 encoded audio or an audio URL to a vLLM served audio model
run_video_chat: run video inference by sending a video URL or base64 encoded video to a vLLM served model via OpenAI client
run_text_only_chat: run text only chat completion inference against a vLLM served multimodal model using the OpenAI client
